reason: $24.99 for the first box with a money-back promise is low enough to try once, and a sachet a day is easier for me than a bottle I forget on the counter. I would not stock up until I see it work.
objection: It is still two capsules every day, and I forget vitamins half the time. If I skip days I will have paid for a box I did not finish, and the refund only works if I take all 30.
would_change_my_mind: A coupon or bundle that brings the box under $20, or a refund that does not require finishing all 30 sachets.
